name: set_map_effect_position_from_object_attachment

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetMapEffectPositionFromObjectAttachment consumes effect ID, object ID, attachment ID, and offset, resolves the map effect through func_00177608 and the object through func_001EAB00, passes attachment_id and half-scaled offset to func_001314D0, copies the resulting attachment vector to the map effect, and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: This is the one-shot counterpart of command 196 attach_map_effect_to_object, whose update task repeatedly performs the same attachment-point calculation. The sole JP call occurs in al02.ard during a Cave of Wonders effect sequence and passes effect ID 0, object ID 4304, attachment ID 2, and offset 4.
